content.prompt:
Eflal is approximately $170\text{ cm}$ tall.
To calculate the height of a building, she stands at a point and measures the angle of elevation to the top of the building as $45^\circ$.
She then walks $25.7$ metres further away from the building and measures the angle of elevation as $30^\circ$.
Find the height of the building, correct to the nearest metre.
Draw a diagram to support your response.

answer.worked:
Let the height of the building be $h$ metres. Since Eflal's eye level is $1.7$ metres above the ground, the vertical height from eye level to the top of the building is $h-1.7$.

At the closer point, the angle of elevation is $45^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
\tan(45^\circ) &= \frac{h-1.7}{d} \\
d &= h-1.7
\end{align*}$$
At the further point, the horizontal distance from the building is $d+25.7=h+24$.
$$\begin{align*}
\tan(30^\circ) &= \frac{h-1.7}{h+24} \\
\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} &= \frac{h-1.7}{h+24} \\
h+24 &= \sqrt{3}(h-1.7) \\
h+24 &= \sqrt{3}h - 1.7\sqrt{3} \\
h(\sqrt{3}-1) &= 24 + 1.7\sqrt{3} \\
h &\approx 36.8069
\end{align*}$$
Therefore, the height of the building is $37\text{ m}$, correct to the nearest metre.
